reason: Two-sample Mendelian randomisation on published GWAS summary statistics for epigenetic-age clocks; no epigenetic marker was directly measured in this study.
CAN-BIND-1 participants with MDD had DNA methylation of endocannabinoid-system genes measured and related to antidepressant response, a treatment-selection decision.

Cord blood DNA methylation was measured in an ABIS birth-cohort comparison of children who later developed type 1 diabetes versus controls, bearing on early risk stratification, though the analysis is largely mechanistic network crosstalk.
CHAF1A is a chromatin assembly factor but only transcript and immunohistochemical protein levels were measured; no DNA methylation, histone mark or chromatin state was assayed.
Biological aging acceleration was derived by the Klemera-Doubal method from 11 clinical biomarkers, not from DNA methylation or any epigenetic measure.
Urine PENK and NKPD1 DNA methylation was measured by MSRE-qPCR in 606 samples for bladder cancer detection and postoperative monitoring.
Genome-wide blood DNA methylation was measured in 536 cognitively normal adults and tested as a mediator of ambient PM2.5, a modifiable exposure.
SOX11 methylation in circulating tumour DNA was quantified in 353 colon cancer patients and related to recurrence-free survival, a prognostic decision.
Citrullinated histone H3, a measured histone modification, was assayed in 96 neonates for diagnosis of sepsis, although it is used here as a circulating NET biomarker rather than a chromatin readout.
The ProgEvo prognostic score is built from somatic mutation co-occurrence and evolutionary trajectories; no epigenetic marker was measured despite ATRX chromatin remodeler being among the genes.
IFI44L promoter methylation was quantified in 566 participants across the SLE continuum for early diagnosis, disease activity and treatment monitoring.
Promoter methylation of 12 HRR genes was measured by pyrosequencing in 96 HGSOC patients to predict PARP inhibitor efficacy, a treatment-selection decision.

CARDIA cohort epigenetic clocks (IEAA, EEAA, PhenoAge, GrimAge) were measured and compared by sexual and gender minority status, with stigma and structural discrimination as the socially modifiable exposure.
RASSF1A and SHOX2 methylation were measured in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid from 310 patients in a prospective randomised diagnostic study of early lung cancer detection.
PhenoAge and KDM biological age were computed from clinical blood biomarkers in UK Biobank; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker was measured.
Longitudinal DNA methylation profiles were measured at admission in 75 hospitalised COVID-19 patients and related to subsequent severity trajectory, a prognostic use.
Functional work on CDC6/THBS1 was done in pancreatic cancer cell lines and subcutaneous xenograft mice, with human input limited to TCGA expression data.
ChIP-seq and chromatin work were confined to TK6 cells and mice; the human cohort of benzene-exposed workers had only ATF3 and ALOX12 expression, MDA and GSH/GSSG measured.
Global DNA methylation and Levine epigenetic aging acceleration were measured in over 1500 Women's Health Initiative participants and linked to social determinants and incident hypertension.
TP53 mutations located at CpG dinucleotides were genotyped; methylation itself was never measured, so no epigenetic marker was assayed.
Methylated ctDNA at HOXA9, TFAP2B, MCIDAS and SP9 was measured by ddPCR in 68 NSCLC patients to predict relapse after curative radiotherapy.
Only GPS1 exon 9 DNA sequence alterations were assessed in 106 penile carcinoma cases; no epigenetic marker was measured.
Serum emerging contaminants were profiled in patients and controls, and the only chromatin-related finding is a proteomic pathway signal in A549 cells, not a measured epigenetic marker in humans.
MGMT promoter methylation status was determined in 153 recurrent glioblastoma patients and used to stratify the survival benefit of re-resection, a surgical decision.
Histone acetylation and p300 translocation were measured only in APP/PS1 mice; the human NHANES, Mendelian randomisation and GEO components measured no epigenetic marker.

Chromatin immunoprecipitation was used for YY1 and KRAS transcription-factor binding in cell and mouse models, not as an eligible epigenetic marker in the human PDAC cohorts, which contributed PDIA6 protein expression only.
Only serum inflammatory proteins HBP, PCT, CRP and SAA were measured in this pneumonia cohort; no epigenetic marker appears.

ChIP demonstrated ZNF384 transcription-factor binding to the SLC31A1 promoter in breast cancer cell lines, while the human tissues contributed expression data only, with no methylation, histone mark or chromatin state measured.

DNA methylation clustering was performed in this 14-case retrospective molecular pathology series, but the design does not map onto the eligible study designs and the bracketed title in a Chinese pathology journal leaves the publication language undetermined.
EPIC array DNA methylation was measured in 64 childhood-onset lupus patients and 47 controls and related to disease activity and sex, supporting risk stratification and monitoring.
Spine age was estimated from DXA vertebral fracture assessment images by deep learning; no epigenetic marker was measured.
BDNF DNA methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in 189 children in a prospective cohort comparing traumatic brain injury with orthopaedic injury and tracking recovery.
Two-sample Mendelian randomisation used published GWAS summary statistics for telomere length and epigenetic clocks; no epigenetic marker was measured in this study.
Whole blood 850k DNA methylation was assayed and five epigenetic aging biomarkers computed in 272 MASLD-HCC cases and 316 controls to assess HCC risk.
Nasopharyngeal DNA methylation arrays were performed in hospitalised COVID-19 patients and healthy controls, relating a preventable infection exposure to measured methylation change.
PhenoAge and PhenoAgeAccel in this NHANES 2003-2018 analysis were derived from clinical chemistry biomarkers, not DNA methylation.
Methylated HOXD8 and POU4F1 ctDNA was quantified by ddPCR in 71 metastatic pancreatic cancer patients and related to tumour volume, supporting its use as a burden-monitoring marker.
Sperm DNA fragmentation index measures DNA strand breakage rather than methylation, histone modification or chromatin state, so no eligible epigenetic marker was measured despite the PM2.5 exposure.
Only serum autoantibodies, including anti-histone antibodies, were measured in this SLE cross-sectional study, and antibody titre is not a histone modification measurement.
Four DNA methylation age acceleration measures were assayed in 3840 Health and Retirement Study participants as mediators between BMI, a modifiable exposure, and survival.
Weathering in ELSA-Brasil was operationalised as Klemera-Doubal biological age from nine clinical biomarkers; no epigenetic marker was measured.
A methylation-based ctDNA tumour fraction assay was measured serially in 627 patients on immune checkpoint inhibitors to monitor response and predict survival.

Patients were classified by next-generation sequencing mutational taxonomy and response to hypomethylating agents, but no methylation or other epigenetic marker was measured despite the epigenetic therapy.
Ten DNA methylation clocks and DunedinPACE were measured in 1671 Berlin Aging Study II participants and used to predict incident metabolic syndrome.
A ddPCR assay for hypermethylated ctDNA positions was applied to plasma from sarcoma patients in the METASARC and NEOSARC cohorts for detection, prognosis and treatment monitoring.
A randomised cross-over human trial of plasmapheresis measured epigenetic clocks before and after the intervention.
Summary-data Mendelian randomisation and colocalisation used published mQTL, eQTL and pQTL summary statistics; no epigenetic marker was measured in participants.
Blood DNA methylation of F2RL3, LINE-1, MGMT promoter and SEMA4B was measured in 113 hexavalent chromium exposed workers and 72 controls, a modifiable occupational exposure.
Blood DNA methylation aging biomarkers were measured in 2346 NHANES adults and related to one-carbon metabolism nutritional biomarkers, a modifiable dietary exposure.
DNA methylation age acceleration measures were assayed in 3566 Dongfeng-Tongji participants and related to sleep patterns, a modifiable behavioural exposure.
